status.why: The signing is shown by the stored Governor's release; 'not yet in force' rests on California's general rule that a non-urgency statute takes effect on 1 January after enactment, which no stored source states, and the bill text (urgency clause, operative date) could not be stored. The inference is defensible and matches the treatment of US-CA-08, so the value is kept and date_in_force stays null.

summary_claims.claim: Extends the crime of sexual exploitation of a child to downloading, streaming or accessing a depiction, with an exemption for a child who only viewed a video stream
Adds digitally altered or AI-generated matter to the CANRA definition of sexual exploitation
Passed the Senate 33-0; sponsored by the Los Angeles City Attorney; SB 1381 (2024) already covered AI-generated CSAM

scope.note: Not AI-specific; the existing scope_note is adequate and the record is included under the inclusive rule for non-AI laws that operate on an AI-safety question.
